# TEST

```{shinylive-python}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerheight: 1000

from shiny import App, render, ui
# import hasse_diagram_maker

# 1. Define your custom Python function
def my_custom_function(value):
    # Imagine this is your complex python logic
    return value * 5

# 2. Design the User Interface (inputs & outputs)
app_ui = ui.page_fluid(
    ui.h2("Interactive Python Function Viewer"),
    ui.input_slider("num", "Select an input value:", min=1, max=50, value=10),
    ui.output_text_verbatim("result_output")
)

# 3. Define the Server logic connecting inputs to your function
def server(input, output, session):
    @output
    @render.text
    def result_output():
        # Get the input value from the user interface
        val = input.num()
        
        # Pass it to your Python function
        output_value = my_custom_function(val)
        
        return f"Result of your Python function: {output_value}"

app = App(app_ui, server)
```
